admin_claim_not_yours: This button is not for you

Or by hand: put your Telegram ID %s into ALLOWED_IDS in %s and restart the bot: systemctl restart %s

Only the server owner can appoint administrators.

ag_ask_ips: Which addresses may use this grant? Send IPv4 addresses or subnets, comma-separated (e.g. 203.0.113.5,198.51.100.0/24) — or press the button to accept any.
ag_ask_label: Send a label for the grant — who it is (e.g. Claude Code on the laptop).
ag_ask_mode: How the agent will sign in:
ag_ask_pin: Pin the grant to the address it is first used from? The server will then accept only that address — a safety net in case both the URL and the token leak. Pinning can be removed in the card.
ag_bad_ips: ❌ IPv4 addresses or subnets, comma-separated, e.g. 203.0.113.5,198.51.100.0/24. Prefix from /1 to /32.
ag_btn_pin_yes: ⚲ Yes, pin to the first address
ag_card_frozen: The grant is frozen: a clone was detected
ag_card_mode_connect: 🔌 connect — a one-shot key kept and turned by the connector
ag_card_mode_rolling: 🔁 rolling — a one-shot key, every request issues the next one
ag_card_mode_static: static — a permanent token in the header
ag_delete_warn_fmt: Grant %s will be deleted: an agent with this URL gets 404 on its very next request.
ag_enroll_expired_note: ⌛ The enrollment code expired and the grant was never enrolled. Reissue the grant when the agent machine is at hand: the new code is valid for 10 minutes.
ag_enroll_pending_note: ⏳ Waiting for the connector to enroll. The code is shown once at issue and is valid for 10 minutes; lost or expired — reissue the grant to get a new code.
ag_extend_ask: Extend by how long? The address and token don’t change, no need to reconfigure the agent.
ag_extend_forever_warn: Remove the term? An unlimited grant never expires by itself: if the address leaks, it keeps working until you delete it.
ag_extend_sliding: The term also extends itself: every successful call pushes it by the issued duration.
ag_extended_forever: The term is removed: the grant has no end date.
ag_forever_warn: An unlimited grant outlives even a leak you never learned about. A term can be set later with «📅 Extend» on the grant card — here, in the panel or in the SSH menu.
ag_frozen_last_fmt: The last own call was at %s from %s.
ag_frozen_note_fmt: Frozen grants: %s — they let nobody in and wait for your decision.
ag_frozen_when_fmt: The foreign key arrived at %s from %s.
ag_frozen_why: There are exactly four reasons: the grant really was copied; the agent machine was restored from an old backup; two clients share one grant; the client sent a request with the old key after the answer with the new one had already left (two requests at once are let through — their sender could not have known the new key — but a late one cannot be told from a copy). Reissue starts a new chain, Revoke deletes the grant for good. A reissue takes effect at once: the old key dies, the new one works from the very first request, and the address ban is lifted with it — an honest agent's own failed attempts no longer ban the grant. For a connector grant a reissue is a new enrollment: do it when the agent machine is at hand, the code is valid for 10 minutes.
ag_harden_confirm_fmt: Issue a second-factor token to grant %s? After that the URL alone stops being enough: the agent will have to add the Authorization: Bearer … header, otherwise it gets 404.
ag_http_disabled: MCP HTTP transport disabled. Grants are kept, the SSH transport keeps working.
ag_http_off_confirm: Disable the HTTP transport? Grants stay, the SSH transport keeps working.
ag_http_on_confirm: Enable the MCP HTTP transport? A route for agent grants appears on the site and the issued addresses start working from the internet. While the transport is off, agents connect over SSH only.
ag_http_on_lite: In «Lite» mode there is no site, and the transport lives on a dedicated TCP port with a self-signed certificate (the fingerprint comes after you enable it). If you need an address on 443, switch on a site mode («Semi-Pro» or «Pro»): “Settings → Mode and site”.
ag_list_empty: No grants yet — add the first one.
ag_listen_none: Nothing to listen on: a mode with a site («Semi-Pro» or «Pro») or a dedicated port is needed.
ag_mode_note:
The agent is Claude, Cursor or another program that manages the server over MCP.

🔑 A plain token works everywhere, but if it is copied the server cannot tell the copy apart.
🔁 A changing key changes on every request: a copy arrives with an already used key, and the grant is frozen. Ordinary agents cannot do this — you need your own client.
🔌 goamnezia-connect is a small program on the agent's computer (macOS or Linux, Python 3.8+): it keeps and changes the key itself, and the agent's settings hold neither the address nor a secret. After choosing it you get a 10-minute enrollment code and the commands.
ag_not_found_fmt: Grant %s not found — the list was refreshed.
ag_one_client_warn: One grant, one client. Two requests at once from one client are let through, but two DIFFERENT clients turn the same chain, and the second one arrives with an already burnt key: the server will honestly call that a clone and freeze the grant. And never keep the key file in a synchronised folder (iCloud, Dropbox) — it will copy the key to a second machine.
ag_pin_state_wait: on, the address will be fixed at the first call
ag_rotate_confirm_connect_fmt: Reissue the enrollment of grant %s? The previous connector stops working at once, and the new code is valid for 10 minutes — reissue when the agent machine is at hand.
ag_rotate_confirm_fmt: Rotate the secret and token of grant %s? The old URL and the old token stop working immediately; the agent needs the new ones.
ag_scope_note: What the level actually grants. Read only (read) — looking: state, users, profiles, traffic, logs. It hands out NO client private keys and changes nothing. The product default and the least privilege. Read and write (write) — everything read can do, plus: HANDING OUT the private key of any client (one request of a stolen grant carries away someone's working config); creating and editing users and profiles; and — with no confirmation at all — switching the mode, which takes down the cover site, the panel on the domain and the WHOLE agent transport, its own included: an agent that switches the server to «Lite» mode cuts itself off. Full (admin) — everything write can do, plus the destructive part: delete a user, a profile or a grant, restore from a backup, update the core. The agent confirms each of those separately. Take the lowest level that does the job.
ag_sent: Done: the grant details are in the next message. Delete it once you have copied them.
ag_storage_file: as a file — a copy is detected, not prevented
ag_storage_tpm: in the TPM — a copy of the file is useless
ag_toggle_off_confirm_fmt: Disable grant %s? The agent gets a 404 on its very next request. The record stays, you can enable it again right here.
ag_toggle_on_confirm_fmt: Enable grant %s? The agent gets control of the server back at its level — from its very next request.
ag_token_connect: a one-shot key held by the connector
ag_token_connect_pending: an enrollment code, no key yet
ag_token_off: none — works on the URL alone
ag_token_rolling: a one-shot key instead of a token
ag_transport_no_place: enabled, but with nowhere to work
ag_url_is_key: ⚠️ This message is a password, not a link: the URL and the token together control the server at this grant's level. Copy it and delete the message; if it leaked — “Reissue”.
ag_url_selfsigned_fmt: The certificate is self-signed: the agent must trust the SHA-256 fingerprint %s (download site.crt and point NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS at it — see the MCP README).
ag_url_transport_off: The HTTP transport is off — the URL starts working once it is enabled.
ag_url_transport_off_connect: The HTTP transport is off — a connector grant starts working once it is on, and a new enrollment code is issued only while the transport is on.
ag_weak_note_fmt: Grants without a token: %s — strengthen them in the card.
ag_weak_warn: Weak grant: no token. A leaked URL — screenshot, forward, browser history, proxy log — hands over the server at once. Tap “Issue a token”.
agents_body: AI agent access to the server over MCP: a secret URL plus a token in the header, levels Read only (read) / Read and write (write) / Full (admin), expiry (30 days by default), address pinning and one-button revocation. Over SSH an agent connects even without the HTTP transport: claude mcp add goamnezia -- ssh root@HOST goamnezia-mcp.
cmd_adduser_bad: ❌ Could not parse the arguments. Format: /adduser name [GB] [days], for example /adduser guest-1 20 30. Name — Latin letters, digits, _ and -, up to 32 characters.
cmd_adduser_usage: Usage: /adduser name [GB] [days] Example: /adduser anna 50 90 — 50 GB quota, 90 days, keys on every installed profile.
cmd_invite_usage: Usage: /invite ID Example: /invite 123456789 Find your ID via @userinfobot.
cmd_key_no_user_fmt: No such user: %s. The list is /users.
cmd_key_no_profile_fmt: %s has no key on %s. Keys are on: %s.
confirm_expired: The confirmation time is over — start again.
confirm_mismatch_fmt: The phrase does not match. Send exactly %s or press Cancel.
confirm_mismatch_port_fmt: Wrong port. Send the profile's port %s or press «Cancel».

dash_disk_critical_fmt: The disk is almost full: %s MB free (%s%% used) — backups will not be taken, updates will fail, a setting may not be saved. Free up space now: trim the logs in the panel (“Logs → Space for logs → Trim now”) or delete old backup archives on the server.
dash_disk_low_fmt: Low disk space: %s MB free (%s%% used) — updates and nightly backups will soon start failing. Free up space: trim the logs in the panel (“Logs → Space for logs → Trim now”) or delete old backup archives on the server.
dash_kmod_unpatched: AmneziaWG kernel module without fixes: the 3.1 profile can hang the server when users change.
dash_kmod_failed_fmt: The AmneziaWG kernel module did not turn on: %s
s4_risk_fmt: Profile %s: on some networks (mobile internet, PPPoE, some hosting providers) downloads do not go through — the packets are too large (S4 = %s).
dash_docker_unreachable: Docker does not answer — profile state is unknown. No need to restore a backup; on the server: systemctl restart docker
dash_endpoint_gone_fmt: Keys point to %s, but the server no longer has this address — new keys won’t connect
dash_mode_port_mismatch: The mode in the settings and the VPN port do not match — “Settings → Mode and site” explains what to move.
dash_not_installed: goAmnezia is not installed yet: the default profile can be installed with the “Install” button, «Lazy Pro» (just a domain, the bot does the rest) is in “Settings → Mode and site → Change mode”, and the wizard with the mode choice («Pro», «Semi-Pro», «Lite») and the domain lives in SSH.
dash_profile_missing_fmt: The %s container is gone — bring it back from the copy, keys stay the same
dash_profile_stopped_fmt: %s is stopped — its clients have no connection
diag_disk_low_fmt: Free disk space: %s MB — low: backups and updates will start failing.
diag_docker_mismatch: Docker versions diverged: the package was upgraded, but the service was never restarted. goAmnezia will restart it by itself when nobody is connected to the VPN; to do it now — the button below.
diag_docker_stale_fmt: Docker was updated to %s, but the old service is still running (%s) — the update does not take effect until it is restarted. goAmnezia will do it by itself when nobody is connected to the VPN; to do it now — the button below.
diag_docker_unreachable: The Docker daemon does not answer — container state is unknown.
diag_forward_off: Packet forwarding is off — client traffic will not travel past the server. Fix on the server: sysctl -w net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 plus the line net.ipv4.ip_forward=1 in /etc/sysctl.conf.
diag_net_ok: The container network is in place
diag_net_bad: The container network is missing — profiles have nowhere to start. “🩹 Bring the container back” in the profile card creates it.
diag_keys_bad_fmt: %s: the server key stores disagree — issued keys will stop connecting. Bring the container back from the saved state: “Protocols → profile → 🩹 Bring the container back”, and if that does not help, restore from a backup.
diag_keys_ok_fmt: %s: the server key is the same in all three stores
diag_timer_failed_fmt: timer %s: the last run ended with an error (%s)
dns_ask_custom: Send one or two IPv4 addresses separated by a space, e.g. 1.1.1.1 1.0.0.1.
dns_bad: ❌ One or two IPv4 addresses separated by a space are required.
edge_dns_cloudflare: Domain %s seems to have Cloudflare proxying on (orange cloud). For the VPN switch the record to «DNS only» (grey cloud).
edge_dns_elsewhere: The domain %s used in the keys points only to foreign addresses (%s): users with these keys never reach this server. Fix the A records in the domain's DNS settings.
edge_dns_foreign: Domain %s also points to %s, which is not this server: some users with domain keys will fail to connect. Unless it is your second server, delete that record in the domain's DNS settings.
edge_dns_none: The domain %s used in the keys has no A records: users with these keys cannot connect.
edge_hint: Incoming client traffic per address. «Went silent» — traffic stopped arriving at this address while others still get it: remove its A record from the domain DNS or move the users to another address.
err_lock_timeout: Another action is already running (SSH, panel or an agent) — wait and retry.
err_timeout_fmt: The action did not finish within %s s and was stopped. Check the logs in Status → Logs.
err_transport_fmt: goAmnezia on the server did not answer (code %s). Check that goAmnezia is installed and see the bot logs.
flow_expired: The wait has expired — start over
flow_expired_msg_fmt: ⌛ Time is up: I waited %s min for an answer. Open the screen again and start over.
