install_body_fmt: From the bot you install the default profile — %s, the one the Amnezia app sees. Press “Install” — a free port is picked for you. UDP/443 is rarely needed: the VPN on 443 is the «Pro» mode.
install_ssh_hint: The full wizard (mode, domain, profiles and their ports) is in SSH: %s.
internal_error: ⚠️ Internal error. Try again or open /start.
key_addr_dark_warn: This address went silent — the key may not connect.
key_addr_gone: The address is no longer on the server — pick another one.
key_addr_none: The server has no other address right now — the keys already point to the only one.
key_addr_pick: Same key — only the server address inside changes. Pick an address:
key_caption_fmt: %s · AmneziaWG %s · for the AmneziaVPN app %s or newer
key_conf_hint: File for an AmneziaWG client (phone, computer, router); in the AmneziaWG app — “+” → “Import from file”. It contains the private key — do not forward it to strangers.
key_disabled_warn: ⚠️ The user is disabled (quota, expiry or manually) — this key will not connect until the user is enabled again.
key_pick_style: Pick the key style: .conf for the AmneziaWG client or a key for the Amnezia app.
key_qr_conf_hint: QR for the AmneziaWG app: “+” → “QR code”.
key_qr_vpn_hint: QR for the AmneziaVPN app: “Add” → “QR code”.
key_qr_vpn_series_hint: A series of %s QR codes for the AmneziaVPN app: “Add” → “QR code”, then scan them all in order — the app assembles the key itself.
key_send_failed: Could not send the key — try again.
key_vpn_file_hint: The key is too long for a message — it is in the file. Open the file, copy the key, tap “Add” in the AmneziaVPN app and paste.
key_vpn_hint: Key for the AmneziaVPN app: copy it, tap “Add” in the app and paste. It contains the private key.
lang_product_hint: The shared language of the SSH menu, the panel and the bot default. Your own language in this chat wins over it and stays as is.
lang_product_saved_fmt: Product language: %s. The panel and the bot (for those who did not pick a language of their own) switch over right away, the SSH menu — the next time it is opened.
mode_desc_lite: nothing extra, the quickest to set up — connect by the server address and its own port. From outside it is just a server.
mode_desc_lite_site: a domain, a cover site and the panel on TCP/443 with a real Let's Encrypt certificate; the VPN runs next to them on its own port. If there is no domain yet, or its A record has not propagated, the site comes up on a self-signed certificate by IP for the time being and the browser will warn about it.
mode_desc_pro: the same as «Semi-Pro», but the VPN sits on UDP/443 next to the site — indistinguishable from an ordinary site from outside, the most covert mode. You choose which AmneziaWG line goes on UDP 443; Pro and Semi-Pro share the domain, the certificate, the site and the panel.
mode_sub_lazy: just a domain, I do the rest
lazy_desc_fmt: the bot checks DNS and ports, shows the plan and, once you confirm, installs a Let's Encrypt certificate, a site, AmneziaWG 2.0 and 3.1 (usually 2.0 on UDP 443), the panel on the domain and %s keys. The result is Pro, or Semi-Pro if UDP 443 is taken.
lazy_intro_fmt: You send only a domain. I check DNS and ports, show the plan and, once you confirm, issue a Let's Encrypt certificate, install a random site, AmneziaWG 2.0 and 3.1 (usually 2.0 on UDP 443), turn on the panel on the domain and create %s keys with connection pages. Other programs and ports are left alone: if something is in the way, the plan says what.
lazy_ask_domain: Send the domain whose A record points at this server, for example vpn.example.com. I cut off https://, a path and a trailing dot myself and convert a Cyrillic domain to punycode.
lazy_bad_domain: ❌ That is not a domain. A domain with a dot inside is needed, for example vpn.example.com; an IP address won't do — Lazy Pro needs a domain.
lazy_bad_idn: ❌ Could not read the Cyrillic domain. Check the spelling or send it in punycode (xn--…).
lazy_dns_ok_fmt: ✅ The A record points at this server: %s
lazy_dns_foreign_fmt: ⛔ The A record points elsewhere: %s, while this server is %s. Fix it at the registrar and press “%s”: a record takes from minutes to a couple of hours to spread.
lazy_dns_none_fmt: ⛔ The domain has no A record. Add an A record for %s at the registrar and press “%s”.
lazy_dns_unknown_fmt: ⛔ DNS did not answer for the domain — could not check whether it points here. Press “%s” in a minute.
lazy_dns_partial_fmt: ⛔ Some A records point elsewhere: %s. Delete the foreign records at the registrar and press “%s” — otherwise Let's Encrypt may check another server, and users with domain keys may land elsewhere.
lazy_dns_cf: ☁️ The domain is behind the Cloudflare proxy: the site opens through Cloudflare, while keys point straight at the server IP — UDP does not pass the proxy.
lazy_port_ours_fmt: ✅ %s is taken by us — it is goAmnezia
lazy_keys_have_fmt: Keys from the previous Lazy Pro run (%s) stay and count — only the missing ones will be created.
lazy_app_fmt: 📥 Amnezia app containers: %s — I leave their ports and users alone.
lazy_plan_pro_fmt: Plan: %s A Let's Encrypt certificate, a random site, AmneziaWG 2.0 and 3.1 — one of the lines on UDP 443, the panel on the domain; new keys with connection pages: %s.
lazy_plan_semi_fmt: Plan: %s UDP 443 is taken, and I do not stop other programs: AmneziaWG 2.0 and 3.1 go on random ports. The rest is as in Pro: a Let's Encrypt certificate, a random site on TCP 443, the panel on the domain; new keys with connection pages: %s.
lazy_plan_semi_other_fmt: Plan: %s A Let's Encrypt certificate, a random site on TCP 443, the panel on the domain; new keys with connection pages: %s; AmneziaWG stays on ports of its own, no line on UDP 443.
lazy_why_20: ⚠️ 2.0 goes on UDP 443: most clients understand it, including Keenetic routers. 3.1 gets a port of its own; change it later in “Mode and site → 🎯 Line on UDP 443”.
lazy_line443_fmt: ℹ️ AmneziaWG %s goes on UDP 443: I do not move the ports of lines users already use. Change it later in “Mode and site → 🎯 Line on UDP 443”; keys of the moved line will need updating.
lazy_blocked_hint_fmt: I do not stop other programs. Fix what is marked ⛔ and press “%s” — or go back and pick a regular mode.
lazy_expired: The check is out of date — send the domain again.
lazy_unsupported: ⚠️ Lazy Pro arrives with the goAmnezia update on the server: «Maintenance → Update goAmnezia» in the SSH menu.
lazy_installed_note: The server already has profiles and users — they stay. If a profile port changes, the result says so: keys issued with the old port stop connecting, users will need new configs.
lazy_long_note: It takes a while — up to half an hour: certificate, site, AmneziaWG images, keys. The bot is busy all that time; the result comes as a message.
lazy_running_fmt: Installing Lazy Pro on %s — up to half an hour: certificate, site, profiles, panel, keys. The result comes as a message.
lazy_done_udp443_none: UDP 443 is taken — AmneziaWG is on ports of its own.
lazy_done_udp443_free: No line on UDP 443: AmneziaWG is on ports of its own.
lazy_done_port_moved_fmt: ⚠️ %s: port %s → %s — keys issued earlier on this line stop connecting, send users new configs.
lazy_done_panel_fmt: The panel on the domain is on — the “%s” button below.
lazy_done_keys_fmt: Keys: %s — connection pages in the next message.
lazy_done_keys_nopages_fmt: Keys: %s — connection pages are issued in the user's card.
lazy_pages_hint: Each link is a user's key: give it only to them. The pages live 30 days; the QR and a new link are in the user's card (“%s”).
lazy_page_none: no page — issue one in the user's card
lazy_code_dns_none: ⛔ The domain has no A records.
lazy_code_dns_elsewhere: ⛔ The domain does not point at this server.
lazy_code_dns_unknown: ⛔ DNS did not answer for the domain — could not check whether it points here; retry the check in a minute.
lazy_code_dns_partial: ⚠️ Some A records of the domain point to other addresses — users with domain keys may land elsewhere; delete the extra records at the registrar.
lazy_code_aaaa_foreign: ⚠️ The domain's AAAA (IPv6) record points elsewhere — delete it or point it to the server's IPv6.
lazy_code_cloudflare_proxied: ☁️ The domain is behind the Cloudflare proxy — keys point at the server IP.
lazy_code_tcp80_busy: ⛔ TCP 80 is taken by another program — Let's Encrypt issues the certificate through it.
lazy_code_tcp443_busy: ⛔ TCP 443 is taken by another program — the site has nowhere to go.
lazy_code_tcp443_app: ⛔ TCP 443 is held by an Amnezia app container (Xray or Cloak): users connect through it, and I do not break them silently.
lazy_code_udp443_busy: ⚠️ UDP 443 is taken — the profiles go on random ports.
lazy_code_no_line_for_443: ℹ️ Both AmneziaWG lines (2.0 and 3.1) already sit on ports of their own, and I do not move ports users use — hence Semi-Pro, not Pro. A line can go on UDP 443 later, separately: “Line on UDP 443” when switching to Pro (“Mode and site → Change mode → Switch to Pro”). The port changes for that line's users — their keys will need updating.
lazy_code_awg2_container_busy: ⛔ Slot awg2 is taken by the Amnezia app container amnezia-awg2 with users, and adopting it failed — installing over it would delete their keys. Adopt it: “⚙️ Maintenance → 📥 Import from Amnezia”.
lazy_code_template_fallback: ⚠️ The site template did not download in three attempts — the built-in stub is up; change it in “Mode and site → 🎨 Site template”.
lazy_code_cert_fallback: ⚠️ Let's Encrypt issued no certificate — the site runs on the fallback self-signed one and the browser will warn. When the A record points here, issue the certificate in the SSH menu: “Settings → Mode and site → Certificate”.
cert_fail_title: Let's Encrypt did not issue a certificate.
cert_fail_title_fmt: Let's Encrypt did not issue a certificate for %s.
cert_cause_dns: What happened: it could not validate the domain — the A record points elsewhere or port 80 is closed from outside. What to do: check the domain's A record and open inbound TCP 80 in the hosting firewall, then retry.
cert_cause_net: What happened: the server could not reach Let's Encrypt — the outgoing connection broke; the domain and port 80 are not the cause. What to do: retry in a few minutes; if it keeps failing, ask the hosting about outgoing connections to port 443.
cert_cause_limit: What happened: Let's Encrypt is not issuing certificates for this domain for now (rate limit): after failed validations — about an hour, after five certificates in a week — up to a week. What to do: wait and retry.
cert_cause_limit_until_fmt: What happened: Let's Encrypt is not issuing certificates for this domain for now (rate limit). What to do: retry after %s UTC — not earlier.
cert_fail_kept: The mode, the site and the domain stayed as they were.
lazy_cert_fallback_fmt: ⚠️ Let's Encrypt did not issue a certificate for %s — the site runs on the fallback self-signed one for now, and the browser will warn about it.
lazy_cert_fallback_where: Issue the real one in the SSH menu: “Settings → Mode and site → Certificate”.
lazy_code_adopted: 📥 The Amnezia app containers are adopted, their ports are untouched.
lazy_code_subnet_overlap: 🔀 The app containers were adopted on one subnet — that is how the app sets them up, and it does not bother the users. To separate the subnets: “🧬 Protocols” → profile card → “Move … to …”.
lazy_code_keys_partial: ⚠️ Fewer keys were created than asked — details in “📊 Status → 📋 Logs” (action audit); add the missing users in “👥 Users”.
lazy_code_panel_off: ⚠️ The panel did not go on the domain — use the SSH tunnel or turn it on: “Settings → 🚀 Panel and mini app”.
lazy_code_adopt_failed: ⚠️ An Amnezia app container could not be adopted — it stays as it is, its users connect as before. Adopt it later: “⚙️ Maintenance → 📥 Import from Amnezia”.
lazy_code_firewall_open_failed: ⚠️ Could not open TCP 80/443 in the local firewall — open the ports by hand, or the site will not open from outside; check with “🚪 Check ports 80/443”.
lazy_code_line_skipped: ⚠️ I did not install one of the AmneziaWG lines: its place is taken by an Amnezia app container with users. Adopt it: “⚙️ Maintenance → 📥 Import from Amnezia”.
lazy_code_profile_failed: ⚠️ One of the AmneziaWG lines did not come up — the rest is ready without it; install it later in “🧬 Protocols”.
lazy_code_site_failed: ⚠️ The site did not come up — the server runs as Lite (the VPN without a site). Retry later: “Settings → Mode and site”.
lazy_code_timers_failed: ⚠️ The product timers did not come up (limits, container watchdog, stats, backups) — see “⚙️ Maintenance → 🩺 Diagnostics”.
pl_ask: Which AmneziaWG line goes on UDP 443? The others keep their ports; if another line holds 443 now, it moves to a free random port.
pl_why_20_fmt: ⚠️ We recommend 2.0: most clients understand it, including Keenetic routers. You can change it later — “Mode and site → %s”.
pl_no20: There is no AmneziaWG 2.0 on the server, and it is the line most clients understand, Keenetic routers included: there is nothing to recommend for UDP 443.
pl_not_pro_fmt: The line on UDP 443 is chosen in Pro mode, and the mode is different now: “%s” → “%s” — the line is chosen right there.
pl_none_fmt: There are no AmneziaWG profiles — nothing to put on UDP 443. A profile is installed in “%s”.
pl_move_fmt: %s goes on UDP 443 — it is on UDP %s now. The container is recreated, its users lose the connection while that happens.
pl_prev_fmt: %s leaves UDP 443 for a free random port — its container is recreated too.
pl_switch_move_fmt: The line on UDP 443 is %s: after the mode switch the bot moves it from UDP %s to 443 and recreates the container.
pl_switch_same_fmt: The line on UDP 443 is %s: it is already there, ports stay as they are.
pl_moving_fmt: Putting %s on UDP 443 — containers are recreated, up to a few minutes…
pl_failed: ⚠️ The mode is switched, but the line could not be put on UDP 443:
pl_adopted_note: You can still move it, only with the phrase below: users whose key was issued in the Amnezia app will have to reissue it or fix the port in the app.
pl_unsupported_fmt: ⚠️ Choosing the line on UDP 443 arrives with the goAmnezia update on the server. Until then a line is moved in “%s”: profile card → “%s”.
mode_ports_lite_site: TCP 80/443 — site and panel; UDP — the profiles' own ports
mode_ports_pro: TCP 80/443 — site and panel; UDP 443 — VPN
mr_fetch_queued_fmt: Download %s · %s queued. It runs in the background; see the state with “Refresh” on the mirror screen.
mr_intro: Copies of official app builds on this server: a user downloads them from their connection page without visiting the stores. The server takes the build from a GitHub release and checks its digest; without a digest the copy is not published.
mr_no_apps: The catalog has no apps that can be mirrored.
mr_pick_app: Which app to download? Only the apps whose builds may be kept here are listed: open source with GitHub releases. There are never copies for iPhone.
mr_remove_confirm_fmt: Delete the %s · %s copy from the server? On connection pages the “Download from our server” button for it disappears until the copy is fetched again.
mr_unknown_app_fmt: App %s is not in the catalog.
mt_dkr_body: The whole Docker service is restarted — needed when the Docker package was updated but the service is still the old one, or when Docker misbehaves. The VPN drops for 10–30 seconds for everyone; clients reconnect on their own. Profiles come back with client isolation, neighbours and goWARP.
mt_dkr_wait: Restarting Docker and bringing the profiles up — usually 10–30 seconds…
mt_dkr_done_fmt: Docker restarted in %s s, the service is now %s.
mt_dkr_manual: By hand on the server: systemctl restart docker (state — systemctl status docker).
km_note: The kernel module encrypts right inside the Linux kernel: on a small server up to one and a half times more speed from clients, and memory does not grow. By default it is the amneziawg-go program in Docker, as in the Amnezia app; the module is used only when you choose it.
km_unknown: The kernel module state was not read — refresh the screen; the SSH menu has the same: “Maintenance → AmneziaWG acceleration”.
km_now_busy: an installation or a switch is running
km_ready_fmt: Module %s is built and loaded while the profiles run the program — “Turn on” moves them to the module.
km_off: The kernel module has not been installed.
km_want_program: The program is chosen: new and restarted profiles run the program even when the module is loaded.
km_neighbour: The module was installed by the neighbour (Kaskad) — it takes care of rebuilding.
km_busy_now_fmt: ⏳ An installation or a switch is running: %s
km_not_here: The kernel module is not possible here
km_consent_q: Speed up AmneziaWG with the kernel module?
km_consent_d: Up to one and a half times more speed on the same CPU, memory does not grow; users reconnect by themselves in 15–25 seconds.
km_plan_reuse_fmt: A module with the fixes is already installed for this kernel (%s) — nothing to build.
km_plan_packages_fmt: I will install packages: %s — about %s MB on disk. Building takes 1–3 minutes.
km_plan_no_packages: The build packages are already installed. Building takes 1–3 minutes.
km_plan_build: Sources: the v3.1.20260906 tag archive checked by sha256, with the kaskad-k31.1 fix set on top (GPL-2.0). Before the switch — a self-test in a throwaway container.
km_meta_warn_fmt: The headers metapackage %s pulls in a new kernel (about %s MB): after the next reboot the server boots the new kernel, and the module is built for it by itself. Without the metapackage the module is not built for a new kernel — the profiles fall back to the program, and the bot says so.
km_meta_auto_fmt: I will install the headers metapackage %s too: it does not update the kernel, and the next kernel builds with it by itself.
km_meta_skipped_fmt: The headers metapackage %s was not installed: it pulls in a new kernel. The module is built for a new kernel only if its headers appear.
km_declined: Keeping the amneziawg-go program — nothing was installed.
km_program_warn_fmt: The profiles move to the amneziawg-go program one by one: %s. Users reconnect by themselves, usually in 15–25 seconds. The module stays loaded — “Remove the module” removes it.
km_rebuild_warn_fmt: I will rebuild the module for kernel %s. If the profiles are on the module now, they move to the program for a while and come back — users reconnect twice, each time in 15–25 seconds.
km_remove_warn: The profiles move to the program (users reconnect by themselves in 15–25 seconds), the module is unloaded and removed together with the sources, the new-kernel hooks and autoload. The build packages stay — I will name them.
km_remove_neighbour: The Kaskad neighbour uses the module: the module and DKMS stay, I remove only ours.
km_busy_program: Going back to the amneziawg-go program
km_busy_hint: The progress updates here every few seconds — the result comes in this same message.
km_installed_fmt: Kernel module %s is built and loaded (kernel %s)
km_rolled_back_fmt: The switch to «%s» was cancelled — the profiles are back on the previous engine
km_left_program: The profiles stayed on the amneziawg-go program — users were not disconnected.
km_fail_enable: The kernel module did not turn on
km_fail_program: The program did not come back
km_removed: The kernel module is removed, the profiles run the amneziawg-go program.
km_removed_kept: Ours is removed, the profiles run the program; the module stays for the Kaskad neighbour.
km_remove_packages_fmt: The build packages installed by goAmnezia are still there — to remove them: %s
km_remove_no_packages: goAmnezia did not install build packages — nothing to remove.
km_client_kernel: a client on the kernel module
km_row_not_running_fmt: %s: the container is not running — %s from its next start
km_row_no_clients_fmt: %s: %s; nobody was connected — the self-test and the interface being up are enough
km_row_lost_fmt: %s: none of %s came back within 3 minutes — rolling back
km_row_back_fmt: %s: %s; %s of %s came back, the first after %s s
dkr_why_failed: the service did not restart (systemctl refused)
dkr_why_timeout: the service was restarted, but the Docker daemon did not answer
dkr_why_still_stale: the service was restarted, but it is still the old one
dkr_why_profiles_fmt: Docker was restarted, but these profiles did not come up: %s
mt_import_adopt_body_fmt: Container %s becomes profile %s, keys: %s. The container is not recreated, the keys stay; the settings and server keys are saved in goAmnezia, the users appear in the list.
mt_import_adopted_fmt: Container %s adopted as profile %s, users added: %s.
mt_import_applied_fmt: Changes adopted: users added %s, keys marked inactive %s.
mt_import_gone_fmt: key %s vanished from the container — removed by the Amnezia app
mt_import_in_sync_fmt: The keys in the container of profile %s match the user list.
mt_import_legend: ✓ — goAmnezia profile · 📥 — installed by the Amnezia app, can be adopted · “·” — cannot be adopted
mt_import_managed_fmt: our profile %s — its keys can be reconciled with the container
mt_import_new_fmt: new key in the container: %s (%s) — added by the Amnezia app
mt_import_no_privkey_hint: The adopted users' keys were issued in the Amnezia app: the server holds only their public part, and the keys themselves are in the users' apps and in the links or files you sent them. Everything keeps working for them. To have a key here too, use “Attach the old key” in the user card and send that vpn:// link or .conf file. Or “Reissue the key”: the user gets a new one, and the old one stops connecting at once.
mt_import_reason_managed: the container is already managed by goAmnezia
mt_import_reason_no_conf: the container has no AmneziaWG config
mt_import_reason_profile_exists: the profile for this container is already installed — remove it first
mt_import_reason_unknown_kind: unknown container kind (goAmnezia knows amnezia-awg, amnezia-awg1/2/3)
mt_import_reason_unsupported_container: this container was installed by the Amnezia app and goAmnezia does not support it: the product works with AmneziaWG only
mt_import_overlap: Adopted as is: the Amnezia app puts its containers on one subnet.
mt_restart_all_body: Every installed profile is restarted one by one; clients reconnect on their own.
mt_restart_all_bot_note: The bot and the panel are not restarted from the bot: systemctl restart goamnezia-bot goamnezia-admin over SSH.
mt_restore_warn: Restoring overwrites the config and users and recreates the containers.
mt_selfupdate_hint: Updates are installed from the SSH menu: «Maintenance → Update goAmnezia» (or rerun the README install command on the server).
ntf_agent_clone_fmt: 🚨 Agent grant %s (%s) is FROZEN: a key arrived that the real agent cannot possibly still have. The clone: %s from %s. The last own call: %s from %s. Either the grant was copied, or the agent machine was restored from an old backup, or two clients share one grant, or the client sent a request with the old key after the answer with the new one had already left.
ntf_agent_clone_live_fmt: 🚨 Agent grant %s (%s): a key arrived that the real agent cannot possibly still have, but FREEZING THE GRANT FAILED — the grant registry on the server was not written. The grant is ALIVE and the clone keeps working. The clone: %s from %s. The last own call: %s from %s. Revoke the grant right now with “Revoke for good”, then find out why the file does not get written: disk space, permissions, a broken agents.json.
ntf_agent_enrolled_fmt: 🔌 Agent grant %s (%s) was enrolled by a connector from %s, the key is kept %s. If you did not enroll it — reissue the grant in Settings → 🤖 Agent access: the previous enrollment stops working at once.
ntf_agent_expired_fmt: ⏳ Agent grant %s (%s) expired on %s and now refuses every call; the last request came from %s. The agent is not broken — its term ran out: while a grant is being used the term extends itself, and this one went unused for its whole length. Extend it with «📅 Extend» below, in the panel (Agents → grant → Extend) or in the SSH menu, Settings → Web panel, bot admins, AI agents → Agent access → the grant row → Extend: the URL and the token stay the same, so the agent client needs no reconfiguration. If the grant is no longer needed, delete it in Settings → 🤖 Agent access.
ntf_agent_expiring_fmt: ⏳ Agent grant %s (%s) expires in %s days (%s) — it still works for now. The term is extended by every successful call on its own, so a close expiry means one thing: the grant has not been used for a long time. Still needed — wake the agent up, the first successful call pushes the term out; or extend it with «📅 Extend» below, in the panel (Agents → grant → Extend) or in the SSH menu, Settings → Web panel, bot admins, AI agents → Agent access → the grant row → Extend: the URL and the token stay the same, so the agent client needs no reconfiguration. Not needed — delete it in Settings → 🤖 Agent access so it does not hang around.
ntf_agent_first_fmt: 🔑 Agent grant %s (%s) was used for the first time from %s. If this is neither you nor your agent — open Settings → 🤖 Agent access in the bot and rotate or delete it.
ntf_agent_new_ip_fmt: 🌍 Agent grant %s (%s) was used from a new address %s. If the agent did not move — this is a takeover sign: rotate the grant.
ntf_agent_rate_fmt: 🚦 Agent grant %s (%s) hit the rate limit: %s calls in %s s, the last one from %s. The server rejects the extra calls, but the grant itself is ALIVE and not frozen — there is no need to rotate it. If this is your agent, it is looping: stop or restart it. If you started nothing — the grant URL leaked: rotate it in Settings → 🤖 Agent access.
ntf_agent_token_fmt: 🚨 Agent grant %s (%s): a request from %s hit the right URL without the right token. The grant URL leaked somewhere — rotate it.
ntf_backup_failed_fmt: 🚨 The daily backup did not happen (%s): %s. The restore point is still the old one — nothing you added since then is covered by a copy. Usually it is disk space: free some and take a copy by hand in Maintenance → 💾 Backup. The next timer run will try again, but better check now.
ntf_cert_expiring_fmt: 🚨 The Let's Encrypt certificate for %s expires in %s days (%s) and the server could not renew it. Once it runs out, the site, the panel on the domain and the whole agent-access transport die at once: the server stops answering over HTTPS. What to do: make sure the domain's A record still points at this server and port 80 is open from outside (Settings → 🌐 Mode and site → 🚪 Check ports 80/443), then issue the certificate again in the SSH menu: Settings → Mode and site → Certificate — the bot has no such item.
ntf_cert_expiring_ss_fmt: 🚨 The fallback self-signed certificate of the site expires in %s days (%s) and the server could not reissue it. Once it runs out, the site and the panel stop answering over HTTPS and agent access breaks. What to do: reissue the certificate in the SSH menu: Settings → Mode and site → Certificate (the bot has no such item); if the server already has a domain, Let's Encrypt is issued there as well.
ntf_cert_unknown_fmt: 🚨 The expiry of the %s certificate could not be read: the file is missing or damaged. The site, the panel on the domain and agent access all rest on that certificate, and how long they have left is unknown. Issue the certificate again in the SSH menu: Settings → Mode and site → Certificate — the bot has no such item.
ntf_cert_unknown_ss: 🚨 The expiry of the fallback self-signed certificate could not be read: the file is missing or damaged. The site, the panel and agent access all rest on it, and how long they have left is unknown. Reissue the certificate in the SSH menu: Settings → Mode and site → Certificate — the bot has no such item.
ntf_container_fmt: 🚨 Container %s is down. Open Protocols and restart the profile.
ntf_container_missing_fmt: 🚨 Watchdog: container %s (profile %s) is gone. Bring it back from the state copy — keys are NOT reissued: Protocols → profile → 🩹 Bring the container back (the same item in the SSH profile card). A backup restore is NOT needed here: it would roll back everyone added since the last copy.
ntf_docker_unreachable_fmt: ⚠️ Watchdog: the Docker daemon does not answer, the state of profiles (%s) is unknown. The client asks for API %s, the daemon supports %s. The containers are most likely running — do NOT restore from a backup; on the server run systemctl restart docker.
ntf_docker_stale_fmt: 🐳 Docker was updated to %s, but the old service is still running (%s) — the update does not take effect until it is restarted. I will restart it myself when nobody is connected to the VPN; to do it now — the button below or «Maintenance → Diagnostics» (the VPN drops for 10–30 seconds for everyone).
ntf_docker_restarting_fmt: 🐳 Restarting Docker: the package was updated to %s, but the service is the old one (%s). The VPN drops for 10–30 seconds, nobody is connected right now.
ntf_docker_restarted_fmt: ✅ Docker restarted in %s s: the service is now %s, profiles are up (%s).
ntf_docker_restart_failed_fmt: ❌ Could not restart Docker: %s. By hand on the server: systemctl restart docker — or the button below («Maintenance → Diagnostics»). I will try again myself no sooner than in %s h.
ntf_edge_ip_back_fmt: 📡 Server address %s receives traffic again (silent since %s UTC).
ntf_edge_ip_dark_again_fmt: 📡 Reminder: server address %s is still silent — since %s UTC. Users whose keys point at it: %s.
ntf_edge_ip_dark_fmt: 📡 Server address %s has been silent since %s UTC while traffic flows on the other addresses, and on previous days at this time it was receiving — it looks like this very address is blocked. Users whose keys point at it: %s.
ntf_expired_fmt: ⏳ Expired: %s (until %s). The user is disabled — extend the period in the card and they are enabled again automatically.
ntf_expiry_soon_fmt: ⏳ The period ends soon: %s — access until %s. Extend it in advance so there is no break.
ntf_quota80_fmt: ▮ 80 %% of the quota used: %s — %s of %s. Raise the quota in advance, otherwise access is turned off.
ntf_quota_fmt: ▮ Quota exceeded: %s — used %s of %s. The user is disabled — raise the quota in the card and they are enabled again automatically.
ntf_server_clock_jump_fmt: ⏱ The server clock jumped by %s s. Connectors resync with the server on their own, but if jumps repeat — check time synchronisation (timedatectl): grant and certificate expiry depend on the clock.
ntf_server_ip_fmt: 🌍 The server IP has changed: it was %s, now it is %s — the new one is already saved. Keys issued earlier without a domain will no longer connect: reissue them or set a domain in Settings → 📍 Server address in keys. If you do have a domain, fix its A record at the registrar: while it points at the old address the certificate cannot be renewed, and with it the site, the panel and agent access die.
ntf_short_alarm_fmt: 🚨 Short link guessing: %s wrong codes from all addresses within an hour. The core closes addresses with wrong codes in a row by itself; full links, pages and the VPN keep working.
ntf_update_rolled_back_fmt: ↩️ The goAmnezia pro update to %s failed (%s) — the previous version %s is back: keys, users and settings are as before the update. Try the update again later in the SSH menu «Maintenance → Update goAmnezia».
ntf_netdeps_dangling_fmt: ⚠️ Watchdog: containers %s live in the network of a container that no longer exists and have no connectivity. Whose they were is not recorded, so goAmnezia does not touch them. If they lived in a profile network (for example warp-socks next to goWARP), recreate them once with --network container:amnezia-awgN — from then on goAmnezia reconnects them by itself.
ntf_disk_ok_fmt: ✅ There is enough disk space again: %s MB free (%s%% used).
ntf_update_stuck_fmt: 🚨 The goAmnezia pro update to %s failed (%s), and it could not all be put back. Open the server's SSH menu: it says what was restored and what was not.
ntf_upstream_fmt: 📡 Amnezia update available: client release %s → %s; profiles: %s. Updates are applied on demand only — Maintenance → Amnezia updates.
ntf_watch_failed_fmt: 🚨 Watchdog: container %s (profile %s) could not be brought up — check Protocols and the logs.
ntf_watch_restarted_fmt: 🛠 Watchdog: container %s (profile %s) was down and has been started again.
online_now_fmt: ● online now: %s (seen in the last 3 minutes)
pf_hint: Free it up or open it:
pg_ask_custom: Type the lifetime: hours with h or days with d — e.g. 12h or 3d. At most 720 hours or 365 days; forever — no expiry.
pg_bad_ttl: Could not read the lifetime. Use a number with a letter: 12h (hours, up to 720) or 3d (days, up to 365), or forever.
pg_card_hint: The address is a secret: the bot does not keep it, it exists only in the message sent at issue time and by the button below.
pg_card_mirror_off: App builds from this server: off for this page
pg_card_mirror_on: App builds from this server: can be requested from the page
pg_intro: A browser page for this user: their keys as links and QR, the apps for their device and app builds mirrored on this server. Lives only on a domain with a real certificate. How long should it work?
pg_link_forever: Works with no expiry — until you revoke it.
pg_link_forever_warn: ⚠️ This link never expires: whoever knows it gets the keys ALWAYS, no deadline will stop it. Revoke it as soon as it is no longer needed or leaks.
pg_link_is_key: ⚠️ Whoever knows the link gets this user's keys. Send it to them only and never into shared chats; if it leaks — “Revoke”.
pg_link_sub_created: A permanent subscription was created for the user with this page — the page hands out its address too (“Subscription” tab). If the link leaks, revoke the page and reissue the subscription with it — and the keys too if the page was opened.
pg_link_sub_exists: The page also hands out the user's permanent subscription (“Subscription” tab). If the link leaks, revoke the page and reissue the subscription with it — and the keys too if the page was opened.
pg_imported_fmt: Profile %s: its key is not on the page yet — it was issued in the Amnezia app, and the server holds only the public part. The user will see there that they already have the key and it works. Press “Attach the old key” in the card, and the key appears on this same page — no need to recreate it.
pg_list_hint: No addresses here — the secret is shown only in the message with the link. Open a page to send the address again or revoke it.
pg_need_domain: The page lives only with a site on a domain and a real certificate (a site mode with a domain). There is nowhere to open it now. You can still hand the key over the old way — a temporary file link works in any mode.
pg_not_found_fmt: Page %s not found — it expired or was already revoked.
pg_qr_hint: The QR is the same address: point the phone camera at it.
pg_ready: The page address is in the next message.
pg_revoke_all_confirm_fmt: All connection pages of this user (%s) stop opening at once. Keys don’t change; if a page is still needed, create a new one.
pg_revoke_confirm_fmt: Revoke page %s? The link stops opening at once; if the user still needs a page, create a new one.
pg_revoke_sub_note: The page also handed out the user's permanent subscription — its address could leak with the link. Reissuing the subscription kills the old address at once; the new one is under “🔗 Subscription addresses”.
pg_revoke_keys_note_fmt: Page opens: %d. Revoking does not cancel the keys it already handed out — they keep working for whoever has the link. Reissuing the keys cuts them off, but also cuts off the user's own devices until they get a new key.
pg_revoke_with_sub_keys_btn: 🗑 Revoke, reissue the subscription and the keys
pg_revoke_page_keys_btn: 🗑 Revoke the page only and reissue the keys
pg_revoke_keys_page_fmt: The keys are reissued on the page profiles: %s.
pg_revoke_keys_sub_fmt: Together with the subscription — also on the profiles it hands out: %s.
pg_revoke_keys_sub_unknown: Together with the subscription, the keys on the profiles it hands out are reissued too.
pg_revoked_keys_fmt: ♻️ Keys reissued (%s): the old ones no longer connect — hand the user the new ones.
pg_revoked_keys_failed: ⚠️ The keys could not be reissued — reissue them in the user card.
pg_revoked_keys_none: No server-held keys of the user were left to reissue — nothing was reissued.
pg_revoked_sub: Subscription reissued: the old address no longer opens, the new one is under “🔗 Subscription addresses”.
pg_revoked_sub_failed: ⚠️ The subscription could not be reissued — reissue it in the user card (“♻️ Rotate”).
pg_revoked_sub_none: The user has no subscription any more — nothing to reissue, only the page is revoked.
pg_send_failed: Could not send the page address — try again.
pg_user_disabled: The user is disabled — the page will not open while they are. Enable them with the button in the card and try again.
share_user_disabled: The user is disabled — the file from the link will not connect while they are. Enable them with the button in the card and try again.
pr_443_body_fmt: Move profile %s to UDP/443? If another profile holds the port, the server refuses — move that one to another port first.
pr_443_site_mode_warn: The mode now is «Semi-Pro», while the VPN on UDP/443 is the «Pro» mode. After the move the mode and the port disagree, and the header says so; to change the mode — “Settings → Mode and site”.
pr_ask_mtu: Pick a button or send a number 1280–1500. Applies to newly issued keys.
pr_ask_port: Send a UDP port number from 1 to 65535, for example 5443.
pr_ask_subnet: Send a private-range subnet with a /20–/24 mask, e.g. 10.8.2.0/24.
pr_bad_mtu: ❌ MTU must be a number between 1280 and 1500.
pr_bad_param_value: ❌ Invalid value: letters, digits, + / = < > . _ - and space are allowed, up to 512 characters.
pr_bad_port: ❌ The port must be a number between 1 and 65535.
pr_bad_subnet: ❌ A private subnet with a /20–/24 mask is required, e.g. 10.8.2.0/24.
pr_install_body: Press «Install» — a free port is picked for you. An own port is rarely needed. Only one profile can hold UDP/443.
pr_install_wait: Building the image and starting the container takes up to a few minutes.
pr_legend: ● running · ↻ restarting · ○ stopped · ✗ no container · ⚠ Docker not answering · ◌ not installed. Tap a profile to open its card.
pr_mtu_hint: 1280 is the standard and works everywhere. On wired internet you can raise it up to 1320 — a few percent faster; if downloads start to hang, go back to 1280.
pr_mtu_low: Below 1280 the tunnel will not come up for clients with IPv6 (AllowedIPs ::/0) — keep 1280 or more.
pr_mtu_warn_path_fmt: A %s-byte packet: downloads will stall at some hosting providers and networks — keep 1320 or less.
pr_not_installed_hint: The profile is not installed. Installing builds the image, starts the container and generates the line parameters.
pr_missing_hint: The profile is installed, but its container is gone. No need to install it again: “🩹 Bring the container back” below restores it from the saved state — same keys, the configs users have keep working.
pr_param_reissue_note: Server-side parameters (S1–S4, H1–H4, HeaderProtectionKey, RandomTrailers, DisableCookies) change every client config of the profile: after writing, everyone needs a new config (user card → key).
pr_param_reissue_now: Old configs of the profile will no longer connect: issue the keys to the users again (user card → key).
pr_param_restarted: The profile runs on the AmneziaWG kernel module — the new masking was applied by restarting the profile: clients reconnect on their own, usually within 15–25 seconds.
pr_param_scope_client: · Client-side parameter: applies to newly issued keys.
pr_param_scope_server: 🔒 Server-side parameter: after writing, every user of the profile needs a new config.
pr_param_value_hint: Send the new value: a number, a range a-b, on/off, a base64 key or a signature packet like <b 0x…><r 2>. The server validates it by the line rules.
pr_core_ver_app_unknown: unknown (Amnezia app image, tag latest; known after an update check)
pr_params_legend: 🔒 — server-side parameter: after a change every user of the profile needs a new config. · — client-side: applies to keys issued from now on.
pr_params_unavailable_fmt: Parameters of profile %s are unavailable — is the profile installed?
pr_engine_pending_fmt: «%s» is chosen — it takes effect at the next restart of the profile
pr_port_confirm_fmt: Change the port of profile %s to %s?
pr_port_note: The port is written into every key already issued: after the change old configs stop connecting — send users the new ones.
pr_preset_body: A preset regenerates the obfuscation parameters: default — as Amnezia does, quic — a QUIC-like signature, router — no signature packets, for routers.
pr_regen_done_hint: Hand the new keys to the users: user card → key.
pr_regen_warn: ALL keys of the profile will be reissued: old configs stop connecting, users need the new ones.
pr_regen_warn_fmt: The obfuscation parameters of profile %s will be generated anew (preset %s). ALL keys of the profile are reissued and the old ones stop working — send users the new ones.
pr_repair_warn_fmt: The container of profile %s is brought back from the state saved on this server: same keys, the configs users already have keep working, no archive needed. The connection drops while it is recreated. This is the answer to “the container is gone” or “the server key diverged”, not a backup restore.
pr_repairing_fmt: Bringing the %s profile container back from the saved state (up to a few minutes)…
pr_remove_warn_fmt: The container of profile %s will be removed and the keys of this profile stop working for every user.
pr_remove_page1_fmt: ⚠️ The connection page of %s stops working: it had only this profile.
pr_remove_pages_fmt: ⚠️ The connection pages of %s stop working: they had only this profile.
pr_restart_warn_fmt: The container of profile %s will be restarted: everyone connected right now loses the link for a few seconds. Keys and settings stay as they are.
pr_subnet_changing_fmt: Changing the subnet of profile %s to %s…
pr_subnet_warn: The client addresses inside the VPN change: the address in every key changes and the configs must be handed out again.
pr_overlap_fmt: Subnet %s is the same network as %s: that is how the Amnezia app sets up its containers. It does not bother the users, and separating the subnets is easy: move %s to the free %s.
pr_overlap_nofree_fmt: Subnet %s is the same network as %s. No free subnet was found for the move.
pr_overlap_keyless_fmt: The users on it (%s) hold keys issued by the Amnezia app — after the move they will need new keys.
pr_subnet_fixed: The profile was adopted from an old app container on interface wg0: its start script knows only the previous subnet, and after a change the container would not come up — its subnet cannot be changed.
pr_subnet_fixed_way_fmt: Its subnet %s overlaps %s, whose subnet can be changed: move it to the free %s.
pr_subnet_fixed_none: The subnet can be changed only by installing the profile anew — keys will have to be reissued.
pr_smv_warn_fmt: %s goes to the free subnet %s, and the overlap is gone. The address in every key of the profile changes — the keys of its users (%s) must be handed out again.
lines_no20: There is no AmneziaWG 2.0 on the server: old app versions and Keenetic routers on regular firmware cannot connect to any profile (Keenetic understands 3.1 only in dev firmware so far).
ntf_dupline_fmt: A bug of earlier goAmnezia pro versions: instead of AmneziaWG %s a second %s was installed. There is no AmneziaWG %s on the server: old app versions (AmneziaVPN before 5.0.1.5, DefaultVPN) cannot connect to 3.1, and Keenetic routers on regular firmware connect only to AmneziaWG 1.5 or 1.0 if it is installed (Keenetic understands 3.1 only in dev firmware so far). The fix moves %s to %s: the port and subnet stay. goAmnezia pro issues new keys to the users on it (%s) right away. A subscription picks them up by itself only where the app refreshes it by itself; the connection page has to be opened again and the new key imported, and those who were sent the key or file by hand have to scan the QR code or import the key again: the old one stops working. The app's profile is not touched.
ntf_dupline0_fmt: A bug of earlier goAmnezia pro versions: instead of AmneziaWG %s a second %s was installed. There is no AmneziaWG %s on the server: old app versions (AmneziaVPN before 5.0.1.5, DefaultVPN) cannot connect to 3.1, and Keenetic routers on regular firmware connect only to AmneziaWG 1.5 or 1.0 if it is installed (Keenetic understands 3.1 only in dev firmware so far). The fix moves %s to %s: the port and subnet stay. There are no users on it. The app's profile is not touched.
dash_dupline_fmt: A bug of earlier versions: instead of AmneziaWG %s a second %s was installed (%s) — old app versions cannot connect to 3.1, Keenetic routers on regular firmware only to 1.5 or 1.0 if it is installed. Users on it: %s.
lines_reline_fmt: %s repeats the line of another profile — it can be moved to AmneziaWG %s: the port and subnet stay the same, its users get new keys.
pr_rl_warn_fmt:
I will remove profile %s and install it again on AmneziaWG %s — on the same UDP port %s and in the same subnet.

• Users with a key on it: %s. Their old keys on this profile stop working — everyone who had it gets a new one.
• The Amnezia app's profile is not touched.
pr_rl_none: Nothing to move: this profile does not repeat another profile's line, or the other line of the pair is already on the server.
pr_rl_others_on_fmt: 🔑 The other users — %s — get a key on AmneziaWG %s together with the move.
pr_rl_others_off_fmt: The other users — %s — get no key on AmneziaWG %s: it can be issued later in the user's card.
pr_rl_others_unknown_on_fmt: 🔑 The other users who have no key on this profile get a key on AmneziaWG %s together with the move (the user list could not be read right now — the server finds them itself).
pr_rl_others_unknown_off_fmt: The other users get no key on AmneziaWG %s: it can be issued later in the user's card.
pr_rl_all_on_fmt: 🔑 Nobody has a key on this profile — every user (%s) gets a key on AmneziaWG %s together with the move.
pr_rl_all_off_fmt: Nobody has a key on this profile (users: %s) — no key on AmneziaWG %s is issued: it can be issued later in the user's card.
pr_rl_keys_on_btn: ☑️ Issue a key to the others
pr_rl_keys_off_btn: ⬜ Issue a key to the others
pr_s4_note_fmt: S4 becomes 12–24 — at MTU 1280 the data packet is at most 1384 bytes, with a margin below %s. The profile restarts: clients reconnect by themselves, usually within 15–25 seconds. Users' keys stay. Apps with a subscription pick up the new settings by themselves (%s) or on «Refresh», the connection page serves them right away; vpn:// keys and .conf files handed out earlier must be imported anew — after the fix you get the list of whom.
pr_s4_keyless_fmt: The users on it (%s) hold keys issued by the Amnezia app — after the S4 change their configs stop connecting: each of them will need the config shared again from the app or a key reissued.
pr_s4_none: The profile's data packet already fits mobile networks — nothing to fix.
pr_subnet_adopted_note: It can still be changed, only with the phrase below: users whose key was issued in the Amnezia app will have to reissue it.
confirm_already_accepted: The phrase was already accepted — the action is running or done and cannot be cancelled from here.
se_alt_svc_body: The site tells the browser it speaks HTTP/3 on UDP/443. That makes the traffic look more ordinary: UDP on 443 stops standing out.
se_alt_svc_saved_only: The setting is saved but cannot be applied now: this mode has no site. The header appears once you switch to a mode with a site.
se_alt_svc_warn: Announcing HTTP/3 invites browsers to UDP/443 — where AmneziaWG sits. Real browsers will stall there, fall back to TCP, and do it on every visit. Turn it on only if UDP/443 really is taken by a profile. You can turn it off at any time.
se_endpoint_ask: Send a domain (lowercase) or an IPv4 — the server address in new keys. By default in «Pro» mode it is the server domain, otherwise the server IP.
se_endpoint_bad:
❌ A lowercase domain or an IPv4 address is required.
Send the address again — or press “Cancel”.
se_endpoint_gone_fmt: The server no longer has %s — new keys with it won’t connect. Pick the server IP or send another address.
se_endpoint_no_ip: The server IP is unknown — send the address as a message.
se_mini_needs_pro: The panel on the domain works in the site modes once the domain has a real certificate: the secret path lives in the domain vhost. The SSH tunnel entrance works in any mode.
se_mini_off: ⏸ Close the panel on the domain
se_mini_off_confirm: Close the panel on the domain? The secret path is removed and the only way in is the SSH tunnel. You can turn it back on at any time — with a new path.
se_mini_on: ▶️ Open the panel on the domain
se_mini_rotate_confirm: Change the panel's secret path? The old address dies at once: bookmarks and the mini-app button stop opening for everyone you gave it to. The new address arrives in the next message.
se_mini_sent: The panel address is in the next message.
se_mini_url_is_key: ⚠️ The address contains the secret path: whoever sees it opens the panel. Copy it and delete the message; if it leaked — “Rotate the secret path”.
se_mode_ask_domain: Send the domain whose A record already points at this server (for example vpn.example.com). Until the record propagates the certificate cannot be issued.
se_mode_bad_domain: ❌ A lowercase domain with a dot inside is expected, for example vpn.example.com.
se_mode_domain_fmt: Domain: %s — a Let's Encrypt certificate will be issued for it.
se_mode_done_hint: Check the result with “Check site”: it goes to the address from outside and shows a verdict.
se_mode_hint: The mode changes how the server looks from outside. Profiles, keys and users are left untouched by a mode change.
se_mode_no_domain_btn: No domain — a self-signed certificate by IP
se_mode_port_hint: The mode did not move the VPN port: TCP/443 now carries the site and the panel, while the profile still listens on its old UDP port. To put the VPN on 443 as well use “Take UDP/443” on the profile card: the container is recreated and the keys stay, but the client port changes and the issued configs have to be resent.
se_mode_port_hint_site_fmt: The mode did not move the VPN port: %s stayed on UDP/443, while «Semi-Pro» means the VPN on its own port. To move it use “Change the port” on the profile card: the container is recreated and the keys stay, but the client port changes and the issued configs have to be resent.
se_mode_switching_fmt: Switching the server to «%s» (up to a few minutes: certificate, site, nginx)…
se_mode_unsure: If unsure: with a domain choose «Semi-Pro», without one choose «Lite».
se_mode_warn_fmt: The mode becomes %s: %s nginx and a cover site go up on TCP/443 with a Let's Encrypt certificate for the domain (no domain — the fallback self-signed one by IP), and the panel on the domain turns on by itself. The VPN port is not moved. User keys and containers stay as they are.
se_mode_warn_pro_fmt: The mode becomes %s: %s nginx and a cover site go up on TCP/443 with a Let's Encrypt certificate for the domain (no domain — the fallback self-signed one by IP), and the panel on the domain turns on by itself.
se_mode_warn_off_fmt: The mode becomes %s: %s The nginx config is removed, 80 and 443/tcp stop answering; site files, the domain and the certificate stay on disk. The panel on the domain and agent URLs stop opening. User keys and containers stay as they are.
se_mode_warn_switch_fmt: The mode becomes %s: %s The site, the domain, the certificate and the panel stay as they are — only the mode record changes. The VPN port is not moved: if it does not match the mode, the bot offers the move as a separate step (the port is written into every issued key). User keys and containers stay as they are.
se_mode_warn_pro_switch_fmt: The mode becomes %s: %s The site, the domain, the certificate and the panel stay as they are.
se_mode_warn_keys_host: The address in new keys may change: the domain goes there only in «Pro», the other modes use the server IP. Keys already issued keep connecting while their port stays the same; the reply to the switch will say exactly.
se_panel_no_place: The panel path is saved, but there is no panel on the domain: in this mode the secret path has nowhere to live. The SSH tunnel entrance still works.
se_panel_off: The panel on the domain is off. The SSH tunnel entrance still works.
se_panel_on: The panel on the domain is on — open it with the button below.
se_panel_ssh_hint: Panel installation, its password and the emergency login token are in the SSH menu: Settings → Web panel, bot admins, AI agents → Panel and mini app.
sec_service_hint: Actions done rarely and by hand.
sec_settings_hint: Set once: mode, DNS, access, language.
sec_state_hint: Status, traffic, logs and addresses — read-only.
share_fmt_vpn: 🔑 Amnezia app key as a file
share_hint: A link helps where a Telegram document does not: a router, someone else's computer, a desktop without Telegram. QR codes stay on the buttons above.
share_link_is_key: ⚠️ The address is the key: whoever opens it downloads the file with the private key. Do not forward it; when you are done press “Revoke share”.
share_link_ttl_fmt: Valid for %s min — then the bot deletes this message itself.
share_list_hint: The secret part of the address is not here — it was only in the message where the link was issued.
share_no_peers: The user has no keys yet — nothing to share.
share_pick_format_fmt: Profile %s. What goes into the file?
share_pick_profile: Which profile's file should be shared?
share_ready: The address is in the next message.
share_revoke_all_confirm: Revoke EVERY active share? The listeners go down, the files are wiped, and links already sent stop working — nothing brings them back, the share has to be created anew.
share_selfsigned_warn: The certificate is self-signed — the browser will warn about an insecure connection. That is expected: the server has no domain, authenticity is verified by the fingerprint.
shl_2fa_note: 🔐 Short links work with 2FA via the Telegram bot: every new sign-in and every replacement is confirmed by an administrator in this bot.
shl_app_note: An app or a router picks the link up once a sign-in from a browser in the same network is confirmed.
shl_bad_answer: The core answered without a short link — it looks older than the bot. Update goAmnezia pro.
shl_ban_step_ip_1: banned for a day (the first time)
shl_ban_step_code_1: frozen for a day (the first time)
shl_bans_note: An address is closed right after “Not me” or after three wrong codes in a row, a link is frozen after three wrong numbers in a row; for a day the first time, for a month after that. Only short links are closed: full links, pages and the VPN keep working, and a code already fetched from that address keeps working during the ban.
shl_cmd_fmt: Router command — press and hold to copy: %s
shl_done_denied_fmt: ⛔ Declined: “Not me”, the address is closed right away — %s
shl_done_frozen_fmt: 🧊 Declined: a wrong number for the third time in a row, the link is frozen — %s
shl_err_retry: Retry in a minute; if it fails again, check the logs in Status → Logs.
shl_err_transport: goAmnezia on the server did not answer. Check that goAmnezia is installed and see the bot logs.
shl_link_new_fmt: ↻ New short link — %s · the old one no longer works
shl_link_lost: The replacement is confirmed, but the new link could not be fetched — open “🔗 Short links” in the subscription.
shl_link_replaced_fmt: ↻ The short link is replaced — %s The old one no longer works: the new one is in the message below.
shl_list_have: Created — the link itself comes by the button in a separate message:
shl_list_none: No short links yet: each appears when first shown — “🔗 Short link” of an app in “🔗 Subscription addresses”.
shl_need_bot: Short links work only with 2FA via the Telegram bot, and the core considers the bot not set up. Check “Telegram bot” in the SSH menu.
shl_reason_misses: guessing: three wrong codes in a row
shl_reason_wrong: three wrong numbers in a row
shl_replace_how: Press this number in the “Short link replacement” message — it is coming to every administrator now. The old link stops working once confirmed; the new one comes here.
shl_typing_note: Dashes and case do not matter: O reads as 0, I and L as 1.
shl_unban_gone: This ban is already gone — the list is refreshed.
shl_way_note: “🔗 Short link” — to type by hand; it works with 2FA via the Telegram bot: you confirm the sign-in by pressing in the bot the number from the device screen.
site_cert_selfsigned: self-signed for the server IP (browsers warn — this stub site is for scanners, not people)
site_check_aaaa_fmt: %s has an AAAA record (IPv6) that is not this server: %s. Let’s Encrypt tries IPv6 first and may fail to issue the certificate — delete the record or point it to the server’s IPv6.
site_verdict_cert_expiring: The certificate expires soon — renew it.
site_verdict_dns_mismatch: The domain's A record does not point at this server. Fix DNS and check again.
site_verdict_dns_partial: Some of the domain's A records point to foreign addresses: VPN keys with this domain will connect only some of the time, and Let's Encrypt may fail to renew the certificate. This is often the hoster's default record or a leftover of an old server — delete it in the DNS panel and keep only this server's addresses.
site_verdict_dns_unknown: The site answers, but DNS did not — the domain's A records could not be checked. Retry in a couple of minutes; if it keeps happening, check the server's own DNS resolvers.
site_verdict_http_error: The site does not answer over HTTPS. Check the nginx logs.
site_verdict_no_cert: There is no certificate. Turning the site mode on again usually helps.
site_verdict_no_domain: No domain is set — there is nothing to issue a Let's Encrypt certificate for.
site_verdict_no_site: The template is not deployed: there is no index.html in the site directory.
site_verdict_not_pro: «Lite» mode: there is no site to check.
site_verdict_ok: The site and the certificate are fine.
st_logs_empty_fmt: The log of %s is empty or unavailable.
st_logs_awg_off: There are no AmneziaWG logs here: the profile containers run without logs (--log-driver none), just like the Amnezia app's own. Whether a profile works — in «Protocols», who connects and how much — in «Status → Traffic».
st_traffic_more_fmt: … and %s more — online and the most active are shown above
state_docker_unreachable: state unknown (the Docker daemon is unreachable)
stranger_private_bot_fmt: 🔒 This is the bot of a private server. If you are its owner, open the server's SSH terminal — the binding request will be there (SSH menu «Telegram bot → Administrators → Bind by message»). Your Telegram ID: %s
sub_client_gone: This app is no longer in the subscription — pick from the list again.
sub_client_send_failed: Could not send it — press the app again.
sub_copy_cmd_fmt: The command for %s — press and hold to copy:
sub_copy_conf_fmt: The .conf text for %s — press and hold to copy:
sub_copy_file_fmt: The key for %s — as a file: it did not fit into a message.
sub_copy_key_fmt: The vpn:// key for %s — press and hold to copy:
sub_copy_url_fmt: The link for %s — press and hold to copy:
sub_for_conf: A router (Keenetic, OpenWrt), WG Tunnel, INCY, the AmneziaWG app — a .conf file of one line (for a router, for example, AmneziaWG 2.0):
sub_no20_note: There is no AmneziaWG 2.0 line behind this link — old app versions cannot connect to 3.1 with it, and Keenetic routers on regular firmware only to 1.5 or 1.0 if it is there (3.1 is dev firmware only so far).
sub_for_mihomo: Clash Verge Rev, FlClash, Mihomo Party, Clash Meta for Android — a mihomo profile with every line (add it as a subscription by link):
sub_for_vpn: The Amnezia app — a vpn:// key (open the link and copy the key):
sub_grp_auto_note: Updates itself — the app fetches a fresh key by the subscription on its own: a new key or port needs nothing from you.
sub_grp_once_note: One-time — the key is added by the link once: if the key or port changes, add it again.
sub_intro: A subscription is one permanent link per user: Clash Verge Rev, FlClash and a router fetch the keys by it themselves and refresh them every few hours. A reissued key or a new port arrives by itself, the address stays the same.
sub_is_key: ⚠️ Whoever knows the address gets this user's keys, and the address has no expiry. Leaked — «♻️ Rotate».
sub_keyless_fmt: Profiles %s — the key was issued in the Amnezia app and is not on the server: the subscription does not serve these lines until the old key is attached.
sub_need_domain: A subscription works only on a site with a domain and a real certificate, and this server has none now. Without it the key is handed over as before: the key buttons in the card, a temporary link or a connection page.
sub_no_keys: The user has no keys on the server now — the subscription addresses answer 404. Issue a key and the subscription starts serving it.
sub_once_note: One-time — if the key or port changes, add it again
sub_paused: The subscription is paused: the site is not on a domain with a trusted certificate. The secret is kept — once the domain is back, the same address works again.
sub_pick: Pick the user's app — I will send the link, the QR and how to add it.
sub_qr_camera_fmt: By the phone camera: point the usual camera — %s opens.
sub_qr_caption: QR of the mihomo profile — FlClash and Clash Meta for Android scan it.
sub_qr_none: Nothing to draw the QR with: the server has no qrencode. Press “Copy”.
sub_qr_scanner_fmt: By the scanner in %s: point the app's scanner at this code.
sub_qr_url_fmt: QR of the link for %s — scan it in the app.
sub_ready: The subscription is ready — the addresses come in the next message.
sub_revoke_warn_fmt: Revoke the subscription of %s? The address stops working at once; routers and apps keep the last config they got. VPN keys stay the same.
sub_rotate_warn_fmt: Rotate the subscription of %s? The old address stops working at once: routers and apps have to be set up with the new one. VPN keys stay the same.
sub_rotated_ok: The subscription is rotated: the old address no longer works. The new addresses come in the next message.
sub_rotated_pick: The subscription is rotated: the old address no longer works.
sub_send_failed: Could not send the addresses — press «🔗 Subscription addresses» again.
sub_sent: Subscription addresses — in the next message.
sub_update_fmt: Clients refresh the subscription every %s h: a reissued key or a new port arrives by itself.
sub_user_off: The user is disabled: the subscription addresses answer 404 now — a router or app keeps its previous config, and once the user is enabled everything works again by itself.
sub_ways: “QR code” — as a picture; “Copy” — I send what is pasted into the app: press and hold it to copy.
text_no_waiter: I only expect answers to menu questions. Open /start.
tpl_deploying: Downloading and deploying the template (up to a couple of minutes)…
tpl_key_lost: The list is stale — open the templates again
tpl_no_catalog: The template catalog is unavailable on this server: the file is missing or broken. A template can still be deployed from the SSH menu.
tpl_nothing_found: Nothing found. Try another word or category.
tpl_pick_category: The catalog is large, so pick a category first — or search by name right away.
tpl_pick_one: Pick a template — its card is shown before deployment.
tpl_random_body: The server picks the template — a random one from the whole catalog.
tpl_replace_warn: The current site is replaced entirely: the site directory is wiped and the chosen template is deployed in its place. The download from GitHub takes up to a couple of minutes.
tpl_search_ask: Send a word from the template name (Latin letters, 2 characters or more).
up_checking: Checking GitHub (client release, scripts) and Docker Hub (core images)…
up_done_hint: Updates are applied only on demand: backup → release scripts → image by digest → container recreated from the state copy → verification → automatic rollback on failure. User keys never change.
up_none: No profiles installed — nothing to update.
up_repair_warn_fmt: The container of profile %s will be recreated on the same pinned image from the saved state copy. Keys, port and settings stay; the link drops while it is recreated. This is the repair after a failed update — the other way out besides restoring from a backup.
up_repairing_fmt: Repairing the container of profile %s (up to 15 minutes: image, recreate, verify)…
up_rollback_floating_fmt: There is no exact digest of the previous image — the rollback returns whatever is under tag %s now.
up_rollback_warn_fmt: Profile %s returns to the previous image %s and scripts; keys stay, connections drop while the container is recreated.
up_rolling_back_fmt: Rolling profile %s back to the previous image…
up_unreachable_hint: The sources are unreachable from this server — current versions shown. Retry later; rollback to the previous image works without network.
up_unsupported_fmt: The new scripts introduce parameters goAmnezia does not know yet: %s. They are not substituted and not supported; support comes with a goAmnezia release.
up_update_warn_fmt: Profile %s will be updated to image %s: the container is recreated from the state copy, user keys stay, connections drop while it is recreated (up to a minute). If verification fails — automatic rollback.
up_updating_fmt: Updating the core of profile %s (up to 15 minutes: backup, scripts, image, recreate, verify)…
user_add_lost: The wizard was interrupted. Start again: Users → Add.
user_add_profile_none: Keys are issued on every installed profile — nothing to add.
user_add_profile_pick: Which profile should the user get a key on?
user_bulk_ask_count:
How many users to add? Tap a number or send your own — from 1 to 100.

Names come at the next step. There will be no limit or term — those are set in each user's card.
user_bulk_ask_profiles_fmt: Users: %s. Which profiles get keys? Tick them.
user_bulk_lost: The wizard was interrupted. Start again: Users → Add several at once.
user_bulk_creating_fmt: Adding users: %s — each gets a key of their own, a hundred takes a minute or two…
user_bulk_partial_fmt: Not added: %s. Stopped at %s: %s. The users added stay.
user_bulk_where_keys: Keys are in each user's card: 👥 Users → name — QR, .conf file and the Amnezia app key are there.
user_bulk_use_buttons: Pick the profiles with the buttons and tap «Add».
user_bulk_bad_count_fmt: A whole number from 1 to %s is needed.
user_bulk_ask_names_fmt: Users: %s. Which names do they get? 🎲 Random — «Foggy London», «Sunny Manila»…: a label in your language and a Latin identifier. ✏️ With a prefix — office-01, office-02…: numbered after the ones already made with this prefix; the prefix later deletes them all at once.
user_bulk_names_use_buttons: Pick the names with a button: 🎲 random or ✏️ with a prefix.
user_bulk_ask_prefix: Send a prefix, e.g. office — names will be office-01, office-02…, numbered after the ones already made with this prefix. ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, up to 28 characters.
user_bulk_bad_prefix: A prefix is ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, up to 28 characters, e.g. office.
user_bulk_names_prefix_fmt: Names: %s-01, %s-02… — numbered after the ones already made.
user_bulk_del_ask_how:
Who to delete? Up to 100 users at once. First I show exactly who, then ask you to confirm with the number.

Row numbers and checkboxes are in the SSH menu and the panel.
user_bulk_del_ask_prefix: Send a prefix, e.g. office — I will delete office-01, office-02… (the way «Add several at once» makes them). Users made by hand, like office-boss, are not covered by the prefix.
user_bulk_del_use_buttons: Pick with a button who to delete.
user_bulk_del_none_fmt: Nobody found (%s) — there is nobody to delete.
user_bulk_del_many_fmt: The selection (%s) covers %s users, and up to %s are deleted at once. Delete in parts: with checkboxes in the panel or row numbers in the SSH menu.
user_bulk_del_warn: The keys of these users stop working immediately and for good, their connection pages close.
user_bulk_del_deleting_fmt: Deleting users: %s — first their keys stop connecting, then the records are erased…
user_bulk_del_kept_fmt: Left in the list turned off: %s — the deletion can be repeated once the container accepts changes again.
user_added_hint: Keys are in the user card: QR and .conf for the AmneziaWG client, key and QR for the Amnezia app.
user_ask_days: Validity in days from today: pick a button or send a number of days.
user_ask_name: Send an id: ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, up to 32 characters. Example: anna or family-1.
user_ask_new_label: Send the new display name (up to 48 characters).
user_ask_profiles: Which profiles should get a key? Tick them and press Done.
user_ask_quota: Traffic quota: pick a button or send a number of gigabytes.
user_bad_days_fmt: ❌ A number of days from 1 to %s is needed — or the “No end date” button.
user_bad_label: ❌ Empty name or invalid characters (up to 48 characters, no control characters and no backslash “\”).
user_bad_name: ❌ Invalid id: ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, up to 32 characters.
user_bad_quota_fmt: ❌ A number of gigabytes from 1 to %s is needed — or the “No limit” button.
user_del_profile_pick: On which profile should the key be revoked?
user_del_profile_warn_fmt: Remove %s from profile %s? The key of that profile stops working immediately. Access comes back through “➕ Add profile” — with a new key.
user_delete_warn_fmt: User %s will be deleted together with all their keys: they stop working immediately and for good.
user_name_already_chosen: The name is already chosen. To change it, press «Back» in the wizard.
user_name_random_failed_fmt: Could not come up with a name (%s). Press again or send your own.
user_name_random_gone: That suggestion is gone — press «🎲 Random name» again.
user_name_random_unavailable: Random names arrive with the next goAmnezia update on the server. Send a name yourself.
user_name_suggested_fmt: 🎲 %s · %s Take this name, roll another one or send your own: ASCII letters, digits, _ and -, up to 32 characters.
user_no_peers: The user has no profiles — add one with the Add profile button.
user_peer_app_fmt: app: AmneziaVPN %s or newer, or AmneziaWG
user_peer_attach_retry_mismatch: Send the key issued to this very user — or press “Cancel”.
user_peer_attach_retry_unreadable: Send the whole vpn://… link in one message or a .conf file — or press “Cancel”.
user_peer_imported_note_fmt: The key on profile %s was issued in the Amnezia app before the takeover. The server holds only its public part: the key itself is in the user's app and in the link or file you once sent them. It keeps working, but it cannot be shown or sent from here. To have it here too, use “Attach the old key” and send that vpn:// link or .conf file. Or “Reissue the key”: the user gets a new one, and the old one stops connecting at once.
user_peer_imported_short_fmt: Profile %s is not here: its key was issued in the Amnezia app and is with the user (it keeps working); the server holds just its public part, so this key cannot be sent from here. Attach the old key or reissue it — in the card.
user_peer_attach_prompt_fmt: Send the vpn://… link or the .conf file you once sent this user for profile %s. I will check that the key is theirs and belongs to this server. Nothing changes for the user.
user_peer_attach_privacy: I will delete your message with the key from this chat right away, whatever the check says: a key does not belong here.
user_peer_attach_retry: Send another link or file — or press “Cancel”.
user_peer_attach_retry_later: The key was not checked, and I am still waiting: send the same link or file again in a minute — or press “Cancel”.
user_peer_attach_too_big_fmt: The file is larger than %s KB — that is not a key. Send the .conf file or the vpn://… link.
user_peer_attach_download_failed: Could not get the file from Telegram — send it once more.
user_peer_attach_key_removed: I removed the message with the key from this chat: a key does not belong here.
user_peer_attach_key_left: ⚠️ The bot could not remove the message with the key — please delete it from the chat yourself.
user_peer_attach_photo: I cannot read a QR code from a picture. Send the vpn://… link as text or the .conf file.
user_peer_attach_unexpected: This looks like a key, but I am not waiting for one now. To attach an old key, open the user's card and press “Attach the old key” on the profile — then send the key again.
user_peer_attach_not_needed_fmt: The key of profile %s is already on the server — nothing to attach: hand it out with the buttons below.
user_peer_attached_fmt: The old key of %s on profile %s is attached: it can now be shown and sent from here. Nothing changed for the user.
user_peer_reissue_imported_warn: This key was issued in the Amnezia app: after a reissue the user's old key stops connecting at once and they must install the new one. If you still have the link or file you sent them, “Attach the old key” is better — nothing breaks for the user.
user_peer_reissue_lost_fmt:
The old key is gone and the new one could not be created: %s

The user is left WITHOUT access on profile %s. Bring access back with the “%s” button right now — with a new key.
user_peer_reissue_warn_fmt: Reissue the key of %s on profile %s? The key will be created anew: the old config stops connecting at once, and the new one has to reach the client.
reis_pages: The connection page hands out the new key at once — the user has to open it again and import the key.
reis_sub_fmt: The subscription hands out the new key too: the app picks it up by itself on its next refresh (%s), and until then the user has no VPN on this profile; to get it at once — “Update” the subscription in the app.
reis_manual: A key or file sent by hand has to be sent again.
reis_only_manual: The user has no connection page with this profile and no subscription — send them the new key from the card.
reis_unknown_fmt: If the user has a connection page, they have to open it again; the app refreshes a subscription by itself (%s) or on “Update”.
reis_done_pages: The connection page already hands out the new key — let the user open it again.
reis_done_sub_fmt: The subscription already hands out the new key: the app picks it up by itself (%s); to get it at once — let the user press “Update” on the subscription in the app.
reis_done_manual: Whoever got the key or file by hand, send them the new one with the buttons below.
reis_done_only_manual: The user has no connection page with this profile and no subscription — send them the new key with the buttons below.
user_peer_reissued_fmt: The key on profile %s is reissued. Take the new config right here, with the buttons below: the old one no longer connects on the client.
user_pin_common_fmt: %s uses the shared server address again: %s.
user_pin_domain_fmt: «Server address in keys» is set to the domain %s: DNS picks the address. An own address can be set in advance — it takes effect once that is an IP or «Default».
user_pin_domain_result_fmt: Keys currently carry the domain %s: DNS picks the address, and the key does not change. The own address takes effect once «Server address in keys» is an IP or «Default».
user_pin_hint: Pin a server address to the user: their new keys go to this address. The key they have now points to the previous address — issue the key again and send it.
user_pin_none: The server does not see its external addresses (it is behind NAT or has no ip command) — an own address cannot be set. The shared one can always be restored.
user_pin_now_gone_fmt: Pinned %s — this address is no longer on the server, the key cannot be issued. Pick another address or go back to the shared one.
user_pin_resend: The key the user has now points to the previous address — issue the key again and send it.
user_pin_same_fmt: The keys already have %s — the key does not change, nothing to resend.
user_pin_site_domain_fmt: By default the keys carry the server domain %s. An own address takes effect at once: the user's key goes to it instead of the domain.
users_hint: Tap a user to open the card with keys.
users_no_profiles: No profile is installed — install one in Protocols first.
waiting_admin_body: The code is correct. Your Telegram ID: %s Make you the administrator of this server?
wipe_ssh_only: The install is not removed from the bot: only the SSH menu can tear everything down (profiles, containers, keys, users, bot and panel) — it makes a backup in /root and asks for confirmation twice. Run on the server:
